{{Conjecture|legends}}
This was a '''tablet''' that belonged to the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Jorak Uln]], the former [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] turned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] killed Uln in the [[Tomb of Tulak Hord|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]], and may have presented Uln's tablet to Uln's former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] and Headmaster, [[Uthar Wynn]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jorak Uln's tablet was an item featured in the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.
